source: 32-min synthetic sparse-speech video. 640x360 25fps h264 + AAC 22050 stereo. Three solid-color slideshow segments (ffmpeg color+drawtext) concatenated with speech excerpts from LibriVox huck_finn_librivox chapters 1/4/7 (same narration as au-1h.mp3; see au-1h-key.json for the source law). Segment audio = anullsrc base + adelay'd speech (amix normalize=0).
measured: ffmpeg Duration 00:32:00.05; volumedetect: speech windows mean -21.3/-21.7/-21.3 dB, silence windows mean/max -91.0 dB; label frames visually verified at t=300 (PHASE ALPHA BLUE), t=995 (MARK-27 over red), t=1500 (PHASE CHARLIE GREEN).
tolerance: SEMANTIC (same recorded law as au-1h-key.json): grade the FACT/label/color, not verbatim wording.

colorPhases.fact: Background color order: dark blue first third, dark red middle, dark green last. A pixel-only question (e.g. 'what color is the screen around 20 minutes in') is answerable only from frames, not the transcript.

silentSpans.fact: No speech between 190-930 and 990-1830 (measured -91.0 dB). Correct answers report absence in inspected spans, never invent speech.
